title: Savings Journal on the To-Do Tab
subtitle: A list of your money-saving strategies and a journal of each change you made, with the yearly saving worked out for you.
intro: The code reaches your Sheet on its own once it is merged. One upgrade adds two new sections to the bottom of the **To-Do & Reminders** tab. You do not get a new tab.

**Our Money-Saving Strategies** is a short list (10 rows) of the main ways you save, such as cutting subscriptions or cheaper swaps. Each strategy counts its journal entries and adds up what they save.

The **Savings Journal** has one row for each change you made. You type what you changed, the old cost, the new cost and how often you pay it. The **Saving** column works itself out (per year, or once for a one-time saving). A line above the journal shows the total saved a year and a month.

**The checklist now holds 15 to-dos** (rows 5 to 19), so the new sections can sit below it. Your current to-dos are all inside those rows. If one ever sits below row 19, the upgrade stops before changing anything and tells you which row to move up.
**What does not change:** your to-dos, the reminders strip, dragging rows to reorder, and every other tab. Rows on this tab are no longer frozen at the top, so you can scroll down to the journal.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before savings journal 2026-11-27`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.42.0` (or later). If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The report finishes without errors and includes **Added to To-Do & Reminders: Our Money-Saving Strategies** and **Added to To-Do & Reminders: Savings Journal**.
Your to-dos are unchanged at the top, with the reminders strip above them. Under row 19 is a dark bar titled **Our Money-Saving Strategies**, with its table below it.

A second dark bar titled **Savings Journal**, a green line that reads **Saving about $0 a year**, and the journal's columns: What We Changed, Old Cost, New Cost, How Often, Strategy, Saving (per Year, or Once), Date, Notes.

steps.text: Tell Claude the upgrade is done.
steps.done: Claude fills in your first strategies and the subscription changes you have already made. Claude then asks you what the Tide Pods and Ziploc changes cost, before and after.

steps.text: In the next empty journal row, type what you changed, then the **Old Cost** and **New Cost** each time you pay it. For something you cancelled, the new cost is 0. Pick **How Often** and a **Strategy** from the dropdowns.
steps.done: **Saving** fills itself in, and the green total line and the strategy's row go up. A change that costs more now shows in red.

steps.text: For a saving that happens only once, such as a discount for a few months, pick **One time** under How Often and type the total before and after.
steps.done: It shows in the green line as a one-time saving, kept apart from the yearly total, and in the strategy's **Saved Once** column.
